name: jsettlers-p1-dev-t9

analysis: scripts/jsettlers_paired.py --alpha 0.05 --expect-games 1024 --point-bar 0.02 on the two merged receipts (same shard design); the DEV verdict is 'dev_pass'.
limitations: The patch file is GPLv3-derived and lives only in runs/external (never in this repo); its sha256 is pinned here. all_smart makes every locally started robot use JSettlers' SMART strategy params, including our extrabot's inherited fallback brain.
note: Predeclared 2026-11-13 before any game; fresh base seed 20261121; the first sharded table (PR #72), both runs with the same shard design. Launched through scripts/cython_run.py.
